issues.note: Merged into reservoir in import packs; original source headWord/bookId/wordId remain in provenance. No misspelling is accepted as a new spelling answer.

Source sentences are not reliably mapped to individual senses. Their Chinese translations are indexed in source-provenance.json against the corresponding main entry's examples; no assignment to POS senses is inferred.
The term full refers to all retained source senses/POS, not an official examination inventory or an exhaustive dictionary.
